findings.comment: No Electric Service Planning Application (ESPA) approval letter or submission documentation is visible in the site plan package. Austin Energy completeness check being marked complete does not constitute ESPA approval documentation.

Austin Energy Utility (AEU) clearance letter is not documented in the site plan package. While Austin Energy completeness check is noted as complete, no separate AEU clearance letter is visible to confirm approval.

Comprehensive Additional Review Acknowledgement table is not completed on the cover sheet listing all applicable external reviews and approvals (TxDOT permit, railroad permit, gas company permit, easement acquisition, county approval, water district approval, TCEQ approval, service extension approval, etc.) per UCM 2.5.1.F. A partial Additional Review Acknowledgement form addressing only water/wastewater and AULCC requirements is located on Sheet 18, but does not satisfy the requirement for a complete table on the cover sheet.

While Sheet 29 displays the addressing plan with individual unit numbers (Units 101-806), no documentation of approved addressing plan from 911 Addressing/Address Management Services is visible in the site plan package. An Address Validation Letter, if issued, does not constitute an approved addressing plan per UCM requirements.
